tooltip.copperwake.scrap: Trade at a Salvage Bench or craft practical supplies.
tooltip.copperwake.brass_gear: Earned from contracts, machines and forgotten caches.
tooltip.copperwake.memory_glass: Old light, still trapped inside. A luminous building material.
tooltip.copperwake.charged_core: A live power cell. Craft stronger salvaging equipment.
tooltip.copperwake.field_journal: Use to read how to explore, deliver contracts and rank up.
tooltip.copperwake.survey_key: Use to travel to the Rustwild and back. 10s cooldown.
tooltip.copperwake.arc_gauntlet: Use: arc discharge. Mechanist (4 contracts); 1 Scrap; 3s cooldown.
tooltip.copperwake.spring_boots: Handheld burst. Mechanist (4 contracts); 1 Scrap; 4s cooldown.
tooltip.copperwake.patch_kit: Use to restore 2 hearts. Consumed on use.
tooltip.copperwake.foreman_seal: Use on clear Rustwild ground. Artificer (12 contracts) required.
tooltip.copperwake.foreman_heart: A fallen Foreman's engine. Craft a luminous monument.
tooltip.copperwake.salvage_bench: Use: view contract. Sneak-use: deliver completed contract.
tooltip.copperwake.lumen_glass: A captured industrial dawn. Emits light.
advancement.copperwake.root.title: Copperwake
advancement.copperwake.root.description: Craft a Field Journal. The machines are waking up.
advancement.copperwake.first_salvage.des: Collect Scrap from broken machines, caches or crafting.
advancement.copperwake.workshop.title: Back in Business
advancement.copperwake.workshop.descript: Craft a Salvage Bench to handle contracts and rank up.
advancement.copperwake.rustwild.title: Through the Static
advancement.copperwake.rustwild.descript: Use a Survey Key to enter the Rustwild.
advancement.copperwake.paid_in_brass.des: Recover a Brass Gear. Your first real machine part.
advancement.copperwake.old_light.title: Old Light
advancement.copperwake.old_light.descrip: Recover Memory Glass from the machines' lost world.
advancement.copperwake.live_wire.title: Live Wire
advancement.copperwake.live_wire.descrip: Obtain a Charged Core to power salvaging equipment.
advancement.copperwake.arc_welder.title: Personal Thunderstorm
advancement.copperwake.arc_welder.descri: Craft an Arc Gauntlet. Reach Mechanist (4 contracts) to fire it.
advancement.copperwake.spring_in_your_st: Craft Spring Boots. Reach Mechanist (4 contracts) to use the burst.
advancement.copperwake.calling_managemen: Craft a Foreman's Seal. Reach Artificer (12 contracts) to use it.
advancement.copperwake.end_of_shift.desc: Defeat the Foundry Foreman and recover its Heart.
advancement.copperwake.industrial_sunris: Build with Lumen Glass: something beautiful from the wreckage.
tooltip.copperwake.survey_flare: Mechanist: reveal up to 8 hostiles within 16 blocks for 8s. 1 Scrap; 10s cooldown.
tooltip.copperwake.field_repairer: Mechanist: repair damaged offhand equipment by 32 durability. 2 Scrap; 5s cooldown.
message.copperwake.scan_empty: No hostile detected within 16 blocks. No Scrap spent.
message.copperwake.scan_result: Survey pulse marked %s hostiles for 8 seconds.
message.copperwake.repair_main_hand: Hold the Field Repairer in your main hand and damaged equipment in your offhand.
message.copperwake.repair_target: Place damaged equipment in your offhand. No Scrap spent.
message.copperwake.repair_fuel: A field repair costs 2 Scrap. Nothing was repaired or consumed.
message.copperwake.repair_result: Restored %s durability to your offhand equipment.
message.copperwake.mechanist_required: Mechanist rank required: complete 4 guild contracts.
message.copperwake.artificer_required: Artificer rank required: complete 12 guild contracts.
message.copperwake.scrap_required: You need one Scrap to power this device.
journal.copperwake.field_devices: Mechanist field devices: Survey Flare reveals nearby hostiles for 1 Scrap; Field Repairer restores damaged offhand equipment for 2 Scrap.
journal.copperwake.expanded_contracts: The guild offers 22 authored contracts. Artificer orders now tour apiaries, switchyards, observatories and the End without resetting your rank.
advancement.copperwake.survey_signal.des: Craft a Survey Flare; Mechanists can reveal nearby hostiles without dealing damage.
advancement.copperwake.field_maintenance: Craft a Field Repairer; use it with damaged equipment in your offhand.
contract.copperwake.broken_survey.title: The Broken Survey
contract.copperwake.broken_survey.descri: The surveyors lost their compass teeth. Salvage a memory pane and rebuild their bearings.
contract.copperwake.lamplighter_route.de: Someone still lights the abandoned platforms. Bring fuel and a lens before the lamps go dark.
contract.copperwake.sodden_pump.title: A Very Sodden Pump
contract.copperwake.sodden_pump.descript: The depot pump is full of kelp. The mechanics insist this is a materials shortage, not a design flaw.
contract.copperwake.moss_registry.title: Register the Moss
contract.copperwake.moss_registry.descri: The overgrown archive has started filing its own plants. Recover samples and fresh circuit dust.
contract.copperwake.wind_chart.title: A Chart of Missing Winds
contract.copperwake.wind_chart.descripti: The weather engine remembers a sky that no longer exists. Its vanes need quartz, feathers, and patience.
contract.copperwake.cold_start.title: Cold Start Protocol
contract.copperwake.cold_start.descripti: An old boiler only wakes below freezing. Retrieve packed ice and blue calibration powder.
contract.copperwake.quartz_choir.title: The Quartz Choir
contract.copperwake.quartz_choir.descrip: The tunnel bells have fallen out of tune. Nether-grown crystal can restore their warning song.
contract.copperwake.drowned_manifest.des: A submerged freight office owes us a century of receipts. Waterproof the replacement ledger.
contract.copperwake.deep_chime.title: The Chime Below
contract.copperwake.deep_chime.descripti: Far below the mines, something answers the depot bell. Bring back the stone that carries its echo.
contract.copperwake.storm_array.title: Bottle the Next Storm
contract.copperwake.storm_array.descript: The lightning collectors are empty. Assemble an array that can teach the machines to dream again.
contract.copperwake.furnace_treaty.title: The Furnace Treaty
contract.copperwake.furnace_treaty.descr: The old foundry accepts no visitors, only offerings. Deliver heatproof stone and stolen fire.
contract.copperwake.tide_ledger.title: Audit the Tides
contract.copperwake.tide_ledger.descript: Every tide leaves a different total. The dockmaster needs sea crystal and shells to settle the account.
contract.copperwake.moon_audit.title: The Midnight Inspector
contract.copperwake.moon_audit.descripti: An inspector arrives only when nobody sleeps. Collect proof from the night sky and the space between.
contract.copperwake.last_shift.title: One More Shift
contract.copperwake.last_shift.descripti: The foreman's old time clock still punches in. Rebuild its indestructible casing and let the depot rest.
contract.copperwake.apiary_exchange.desc: Bees have occupied the cooling ducts. Replace the seals without evicting the new engineers.
contract.copperwake.silk_insulation.desc: Rain keeps shorting the freight switches. We need flexible thread and tough hide for their sleeves.
The old conservatory stores sunlight under pressure. Replace its panes and living pressure gauges.
contract.copperwake.rail_restoration.des: The depot's return line stops halfway across the flats. Lay fresh track and reconnect its signals.
contract.copperwake.ashen_regulator.desc: A furnace valve glows long after the fire is out. Bring a heatproof housing and elastic coolant seals.
contract.copperwake.observatory_ink.desc: The relay astronomer charts stars through factory smoke. Deliver a telescope and luminous recording ink.
contract.copperwake.end_platform.title: Freight Beyond the Horizon
contract.copperwake.end_platform.descrip: An impossible destination appeared on the departure board. Test its stone and its strange purple cargo.
contract.copperwake.silent_archive.title: The Silent Archive
contract.copperwake.silent_archive.descr: The archive listens better than it speaks. Bring quiet-growth samples and lights that do not buzz.
